campaign.title: Ashes of Peace
campaign.highConcept: The war is over, but peace in the Asterion Reach depends on who controls Starfleet's voice, who receives relief, and whose evidence survives. The newly refit U.S.S. Breckenridge enters that fracture with an incoming executive officer and a command team still learning how to trust one another.
campaign.openingMessage:
Yesterday morning, your shuttle rendezvoused with the U.S.S. Breckenridge while the newly refitted ship held at impulse beyond Mars. The docking collar settled with a muted thump, and the first open hatch revealed fresh bulkhead panels, old deck plating, and a crew still learning the shape of its ship after four months in the yards.

An operations yeoman showed you to the executive officer’s cabin. Four PADDs waited on the desk: your transfer orders, senior-staff dossiers, the refit and readiness reports, and Starfleet’s briefing on the Asterion Reach. The hours that followed passed between those files and a first walk through the Breckenridge—enough time to see where the official reports and the lived-in ship did not quite agree.

Now it is 0830 the following morning. The Breckenridge is underway, and the softer chime of Captain Mara Whitaker’s ready room waits beside your hand. The formal command handover is on the other side of the door.

openingContext.continuitySummary: The player arrived aboard the U.S.S. Breckenridge by shuttle the previous morning, was shown to the executive officer’s cabin, and received PADDs containing transfer orders, senior-staff dossiers, refit and readiness reports, and the Asterion Reach briefing. The player spent the intervening day reviewing those materials and seeing the newly refitted ship firsthand.
openingContext.firstPlayableScene: At 0830 the following morning, the player is outside Captain Mara Whitaker’s ready room before their first personal meeting and formal command handover.
firstSceneGuidance: Whitaker greets the player by name and introduces herself properly before discussing command business.
Whitaker offers a seat and coffee or another ordinary professional courtesy.
Whitaker makes brief, genuine conversation about the shuttle trip, the player’s first impressions, or her decision to request the player for the assignment.
Leave room for the player to answer and establish their own social posture before Whitaker changes subjects.
In the first reply inside the ready room, stop after the greeting, courtesy, and one conversational question or invitation; Whitaker does not pivot into business in that same reply.

Do not mention readiness problems, crew conflicts, the Asterion Reach, flight plans, mission details, reports, command expectations, or the handover terms until the player has answered that conversational opening.
Transition naturally into the command handover only after a human conversational rhythm is established; do not frame the meeting as an interrogation, wartime emergency, or immediate mission briefing.

ship.name: U.S.S. Breckenridge
ship.openingCondition: Returned to service after a four-month repair and modernization period at Utopia Planitia; certified for service with upgraded systems still requiring integrated validation under sustained deployment conditions.

senior.name: Miriam Sato

senior.name: Priya Nayar

campaignContext.missionProfile: Postwar reconstruction, relief coordination, diplomatic support, patrol, survey, and investigation in the Asterion Reach.
campaignContext.playerRoleRule: Locked role: incoming permanent Commander and Executive Officer, serving as principal mission commander under Captain Mara Whitaker.

lockedRole.commandAuthority: Principal mission commander and coordinator of shipboard operations.
lockedRole.captainAuthorityBoundary: Captain Whitaker retains final legal command and may approve, refuse, or counteroffer major mission deviations.

assignmentReasons.label: Part of a newly assembled crew

options.label: Guarded
options.summary: Protects private reasoning or feelings longer than others might prefer.

options.label: Stubborn
options.summary: Can overcommit to a course after deciding it is right.

options.label: Impatient
options.summary: Struggles when process, politics, or fear slow necessary action.

options.label: Controlling
options.summary: May have difficulty delegating when the stakes feel personal.

options.label: Proud
options.summary: Can mistake personal credibility for mission necessity.

options.label: Distrustful
options.summary: Requires evidence and consistency before granting confidence.

options.label: Overprotective
options.summary: May shield others from risk even when trust requires sharing it.

options.label: Rigid
options.summary: Leans heavily on principles, procedure, or doctrine when ambiguity rises.

must: Use the active campaign era, ship, role, and mission profile.
Treat player-entered facts as authoritative unless they contradict package guardrails.
Keep rank and service progression plausible for a Starfleet Commander assigned as XO.
Use no more than two named prior postings by default.
Explain why the Breckenridge assignment is credible.
Leave family, private beliefs, romantic history, and old relationships open unless the player supplied them.
mustNot: Invent secret ancestry, hidden powers, criminal history, severe trauma, or canonical celebrity ties without explicit player request.
Establish friendships, rivalries, or romances with current Breckenridge crew before play begins.
Reveal campaign secrets or information unavailable at stardate 53068.4.
Make the player character universally admired or exceptional in every field.
Let the player character replace senior specialists in advanced engineering, medicine, science, piloting, tactical execution, or intelligence work.
Assume a different ship, captain, campaign, or player role.

continuityGuardrails.label: XO authority
continuityGuardrails.summary: The character is the Breckenridge's incoming permanent XO, not the captain or a civilian specialist.

continuityGuardrails.label: Captain retains command
continuityGuardrails.summary: Whitaker can delegate substantial mission authority but retains final legal command.

continuityGuardrails.label: New to the crew
continuityGuardrails.summary: The player character does not begin with deep relationships aboard the Breckenridge.

continuityGuardrails.label: Postwar plausibility
continuityGuardrails.summary: Backstory must fit Starfleet service around stardate 53068.4.

continuityGuardrails.label: Campaign secret safety
continuityGuardrails.summary: The character cannot begin knowing undiscovered campaign evidence or hidden motives.

continuityGuardrails.label: Specialist boundary
continuityGuardrails.summary: Senior staff remain necessary experts in their departments.
